recentItems.title: RUSSIA STRIKES CIVILIANS IN KRAMATORSK AND KYIV: horrific atermath!
recentItems.description:
Russian occupiers carried out a targeted strike on a passenger bus in Kramatorsk, killing 12 people and injuring 14, while a morning strike on Kyiv claimed one life and injured 11 civilians.

In Pryluky, Chernihiv region, rescuers have completed clearing the rubble of the destroyed building: 22 deaths have been confirmed, including five children, and another 54 residents were injured.

Meanwhile, Ukrainian defense forces withstood a record 224 combat engagements in 24 hours, pushed the enemy back in the Dobropillia area of Donetsk region, and eliminated 1,830 occupiers along with armored vehicles.

recentItems.title: MARITIME STRIKE RIGHT UNDER PUTIN’S NOSE: Russian tanker sinks near SOCHI!
recentItems.description:
A Russian “shadow fleet” tanker carrying sanctioned oil caught fire following a sudden attack in the Black Sea near Sochi. All 23 crew members were evacuated in an emergency.

Amid a series of defeats at sea, the Russian army launched a massive terrorist attack on Ukraine on Putin’s birthday. Thirteen people were killed, including three children.

Ukraine’s response to the enemy’s threats was the official launch of a new integrated structure within the Unmanned Systems Forces. It brings together UAVs and ground-based robotic platforms into a single strike force for combat operations on the front line.

recentItems.title: KHERSON in 2026: EMPTY STREETS, FPV drone hunts and UNBREAKABLE PEOPLE under daily Russian attacks!
recentItems.description:
Kherson is living under relentless artillery fire and attacks by enemy FPV drones. Bad weather and fog sometimes provide temporary relief, concealing the city from aerial strikes.

In this episode of Travel of Our Time, Denys Khrystov shows the deserted streets, the Kulish Theatre, which has remained frozen in time since February 2022, and the dangerous missions carried out by emergency medical teams under the constant threat of follow-up drone drops.

This is a heartfelt story about the unbreakable local residents who, despite the constant threat to their lives, remain devoted to their hometown and refuse to leave the frontline city.

recentItems.title: COUNTERATTACK NEAR VOVCHANSK: Ukraine liberates 10 SQ KM of forest and wipes out THREE ENEMY GROUPS!
recentItems.description:
Ukraine’s Defence Forces have successfully cleared and liberated approximately 10 sq km of forest northeast of Vovchansk, completely destroying three enemy groups of Russian occupiers that were attempting to establish positions.

Despite continued Russian infantry assaults, Ukrainian troops are launching timely counterattacks, containing the pressure and methodically straightening the defensive line in Kharkiv region.

Amid heavy losses, Russian forces have begun actively integrating artificial intelligence into video reconnaissance and drone auto-targeting systems in an attempt to change the dynamics of fighting in key areas of the frontline.

recentItems.title: “WE WILL SHOW NO MERCY!”: Solovyov threatens Finland, Japan and Estonia with the 1945 UN Charter!
recentItems.description:
Kremlin propagandist Vladimir Solovyov has moved from empty threats to fabricating pseudo-legal justifications for strikes against NATO countries and U.S. allies, cynically telling the Finns: “We will show you no mercy.”

To legitimize potential aggression against Finland, Estonia and Japan, Russian propaganda has revived an outdated provision of the 1945 UN Charter concerning “enemy states,” attempting to present this anachronism as a “valid legal” basis for an attack.

Threats involving the new “Rassvet” weapon, together with fabricated accusations against Helsinki, Tallinn and Tokyo of “historical guilt,” point to a systematic Kremlin effort to prepare the domestic audience for an expansion of the conflict’s geographic scope.
